Fixes to the DRUM SEQUENCER from the last build's recording:
- Menus open on the button you tapped (the KIT menu no longer pops up at the corner on every tap, and the screen no longer dims on its own).
- Every button presses in with a short animation; menus and the GENERAL / GENERATE / MIDI sections open and close with animations.
- The grid opens blank, with every other beat's buttons in the darker grey. A pressed step lights its inner slot in the faceplate's colour: MODERN red, VINTAGE cream, TEXTURE blue.
- Space bar (hardware keyboard) starts and stops the sequence.
Still there: sound library on the left (drag a sound onto the rack to add a channel), 12-channel rack with per-track piano roll and dice, SNAP, SNAP TO SCALE, SWING, HUMANIZE, velocity lane, GENERATE, MIDI, PATTERN and KIT pickers.
Please try tapping steps, every top-bar button and menu, the sections on the left, and the pads button to get back to the faceplate.
